notes.title: Update v.1.20.04
notes.content:
GREAT news for fans of REMEDIUM: Sentinels! The game has just received a long-awaited and crucial update that players have been eagerly anticipating. The highlight of this update is the introduction of the [b]"Dash" feature[/b], a highly requested addition that promises to revolutionize gameplay!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/118890eb19c21b474f0e56492c037df1b7923515.gif[/img]

The "Dash" feature can be activated by pressing Shift or X, allowing players to perform lightning-fast dashes, enhancing mobility, and opening up new strategic possibilities. This addition not only accelerates the pace of the game but also adds depth to the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/e07c10371c83a3426df3fad2fdf3e2102d1ea622.jpg[/img]

In addition to the "Dash" feature, the game has migrated to [b]Unreal Engine 5.3[/b]. While this change may not be immediately noticeable, it sets the stage for future improvements and optimizations.

One notable adjustment is the rebalancing of the difficulty in [b]Berserk Mode[/b], making it even more challenging for players seeking an adrenaline-fueled experience. To accommodate this increased difficulty, score points have been doubled, rewarding players who dare to take on the heightened challenges.

Furthermore, we have plans to expand and refine the "Dash" feature for different Sentinels, each with its own unique abilities and characteristics, promising even more diverse and engaging gameplay in the future.

The "Dash" update is a significant step forward for REMEDIUM: Sentinels, and players can look forward to an enhanced gaming experience filled with speed, strategy, and excitement. Dive into the action now and discover the game's newfound intensity!

notes.title: Update v.1.20.03
notes.content:
Greetings, Sentinels!

The game received a small technical update, in which:

[list]
[*] We have implemented a backup system for sending the points scored by the player to the leaderboards. Some of the players reported that their score was not included in the rating, so we double-checked the system for calculating and sending results, and also added an internal parameter for controlling and duplicating sending statistics. Now your record score will not be lost and will definitely get to the leaderboard!

[*] A dynamic resolution system has been added to the game. Its goal is to minimize the load on the system even on weak computers. Now the game, seeing that the hardware is starting to run out of resources, lowers the resolution with minimal loss in image quality and thereby frees up additional resources. A very useful thing for the endless mode!

[*] In connection with the previous paragraph and as part of the overall optimization of the game, some special effects have been improved. Visually, the game hasn't changed much, but it works more smoothly!

[*] Fixed a typo with "Contols". Nobody saw anything ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ
[/list]

You can discuss the changes in the comments or in the official [b][url=https://discord.gg/VR4aTg6nNT]Discord[/url][/b]. Let's [b][url=https://discord.gg/TRHvhDpgGR]talk[/url][/b]!

notes.title: Update v.1.19.02
notes.content:
Hey Sentinels! 

We've done it as quickly as possible, and it's here! REMEDIUM: Sentinels received a content update and a post-release hotfix. In the game, you'll now find peasants trapped in cages on some maps, and your mission is to save them from the mutants. We've also introduced storage areas with canisters. Yes, the canisters are separate from the storage areas. The pesky mutants have scattered green liquid in alchemical containers all over the map, and now you have to collect it back to earn extra points!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/3859c9418cf373029654f4fc73a4eb3e0caa7f2a.jpg[/img]

After the release, some enemies were oddly shimmering with rainbow colors. Most likely, it was due to the fuel from the canisters, but don't worry, we've fixed it, and nothing stands in the way of immersing yourself in the grim "unrainbowy" atmosphere! *evil laughter*

We closed off the locations! Well, not really "closed off" per se, they were meant to be discovered one by one, so you could explore them properly. But in the excitement after the release, all maps magically unlocked for everyone. We celebrated and had enough fun; now it's time to get to work and protect humanity from the mutants!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/c623e637683565fd1db22c2b3f241e574d4e0d8c.jpg[/img]

Oh, and before the release, there was a screen resolution limitation, but now you can enjoy playing in full 4K! You asked for it - we've done it. We closely monitor all the feedback and make all the necessary changes to make the gameplay even more engaging!

And don't forget, [b]REMEDIUM: Sentinels is currently available with a 20% release discount[/b]. Grab it while it lasts!

notes.title: Update v.0.18.01
notes.content:
Hello, Sentinels! In the latest update, the game has received full Steam Deck support, along with several useful features that will enhance and diversify the gameplay. Additionally, we have worked on fixing bugs and added a plethora of new achievements!

[list]
[*] We have added the ability to customize control buttons in the settings. Now you can remap the controls according to your preference for a more personalized experience!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/b94da91094079a128f003db97acd8c7fd523f161.jpg[/img]
[*] In Rush mode, we have implemented not only time tracking but also a scoring system to further challenge players.
[*] Unique objects have been introduced on the game map, which will reward players with points when they are found nearby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/f135a9545515e5c0a3010c6823d9ad9fbafb9f67.jpg[/img]
[*] A bug with the golem's movement animation after victory has been fixed.
[*] Weapon decoy now offers more variability. For instance, there is now an ice decoy that freezes enemies and a fire decoy that deals increased damage, among others.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/105b46995262d73ec74ea18d9f45f9cb6ce663f7.jpg[/img]
[*] Numerous new achievements have been added! These include tasks such as fully upgrading all weapons, unlocking all golems, earning a million coins, defeating 10,000 enemies, achieving specific score milestones, and more.
[*] And finally, the most significant news: the game has obtained the Steam Deck Verified status!
[/list]

We hope these updates and improvements enhance your gaming experience in exciting ways. Stay tuned for more exciting content in the future, Sentinels!

notes.title: Update v.0.17.01
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today's update has brought a multitude of small but pleasant and useful changes to the game, both in terms of visuals and gameplay, primarily focusing on balancing various aspects of the game.

[list]
[*][b] Sound Effects Quality and Quantity Improvements[/b]: We have enhanced the quality and quantity of sound effects in the game. There are now fewer silent moments, and in some areas, the audio accompaniment has been improved.
[*][b] Localization Fixes[/b]: We have addressed errors in some texts for better localization.
[*] [b]Weapon Balancing[/b]: Weapons have undergone significant optimization! To maintain balance, the power of certain weapon types has been reduced, while others have been increased.
[*] [b]Main Menu Button Icons[/b]: We have added icons to the buttons in the main menu for improved convenience and usability.
[*] [b]Experience Bar and Timer Visuals[/b]: The appearance of the experience bar and timer has been changed.
[*][b] Leaderboards[/b]: A score counter has been added, now displayed in the rush mode! In upcoming updates, we will continue to enhance this feature.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/5ef6d93d138416d2b23674703c8440d22109d014.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Session Modifiers[/b]: Before a battle, you can now choose one of five modifiers: four elemental modifiers (enhancing elemental damage) and one universal modifier (increasing any type of damage).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/af4e24daecbd259ad7b57399913ade3d8e6e2c58.jpg[/img]
[*] [b]Balanced Endless Battle Mode[/b]: This has significantly increased the average gameplay time! Previously, the average player could survive for about two minutes, but now that time has increased nearly tenfold!
[/list]
We are continuously evolving the game! Since its release in early access, it has seen significant content growth, and most importantly, the game is constantly being fine-tuned in preparation for its full release!

notes.title: Update v.0.16.01
notes.content:
[b]BIG news everyone![/b]
Remedium Sentinels has just received a BIG update, bringing a wave of thrilling features and gameplay improvements. Prepare to dive deeper into the world of golems and face exciting challenges with these exciting additions. Let's take a closer look!

[h3]Expanded Bestiary:[/h3]
The in-game Bestiary has undergone a comprehensive update, providing players with even more detailed information about the captivating creatures that inhabit this fantastical realm. Study their strengths and weaknesses to gain a strategic edge in your battles.

[h3]New Weapons:[/h3]
Introducing two powerful new weapons: Decoy and Chain. With the Decoy, players can now manipulate enemy attention, opening up new tactical possibilities. The Chain weapon offers a devastating melee option, empowering players to unleash chaos upon their adversaries.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/19a31be5f5c5b1150f33fd93a1ad7ccd8c185d81.jpg[/img]

[h3]Unique Weapons for Golems:[/h3]
The Percussor and Saw blades have been transformed into unique weapons exclusive to their respective golems. Each golem now possesses a specialized arsenal, reflecting their distinctive playstyles and strengths. Master these new weapons to unleash the true potential of your golem.

[h3]Balancing and Difficulty:[/h3]
To ensure a captivating gameplay experience, the experience and difficulty levels have been meticulously rebalanced. Brace yourself for a well-tuned challenge that caters to both seasoned veterans and newcomers. Prepare for intense battles that will push your skills to the limit.

[h3]Level Difficulty Icons:[/h3]
We've added intuitive difficulty icons to each level, providing players with a clearer understanding of the challenges that lie ahead. Choose your path wisely and conquer the increasingly demanding encounters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/cfdc4c8dcf880c589acb0876e6c761d950fe5942.png[/img]

[h3]Enhanced Golem Statistics:[/h3]
Delve into the mechanics of your golems with the newly added stat feature. Monitor crucial attributes such as strength, speed, and resilience to optimize your golem's performance and dominate the battlefield.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/1654ee1189c10ad308603a1730144c459e3ce083.png[/img]

In response to player feedback, the upgrade screen has been streamlined for a smoother experience. When an upgrade option is unavailable, players will now receive gold instead of being presented with inaccessible menus. Use this gold to further empower your golems and expand your arsenal.

notes.title: Update v.0.4.01
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Today we have a fresh update with gameplay and balance improvements, new Sentinels, a change in the skill upgrade system, achievements and much more.

[h3]THREE NEW SENTINELS[/h3]
[i]and reworking the skill upgrade system[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/c1b1bbff2536b640d88d0e47938667543151f5bf.gif[/img]

Three new Sentinels can now be unlocked in the game. We previously divided golems into three main groups based on your favorite builds, and have now created more powerful versions of them: Odin, Abbot, and Archangel. Three new Sentinels have received their own starting skills, and now only they can transmute their special weapons.

In this way, we have made the progression smoother so that you do not have to concentrate on improving only one type of weapon from the start of the game. In this regard, we have finalized the balance of enemies and some skills.

[b]Note:[/b]
Right now skins of the three new  Sentinels is just a reskin of the old ones, but we are already working on a full-fledged new skins. They will be added in one of the next updates.


[h3]Improvements:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/fe3e10f6d9a14f09506fcbe3bcd6324762360f1d.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] RUSH mode now needs to be unlocked;
[*] RUSH mode has become more complex and interesting;
[*] Added 6 new achievements;
[*] Now in the standard mode at the 15th minute you do not die, but "defeat" the waves of mutants;
[*] Optimization.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with playing sounds and music that appeared when there were a large number of enemies;
[*] Fixed a bug with an extra projectile when upgrading the corresponding skill;
[*] Removed several "blind zones" in which enemies did not appear;

In less than a couple of days, we've already got an update for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/04191577e3fdb6318f44b75070fb1752c88e2ce1.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update v.0.0.01
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

we've just released a hotfix for a load of minor bugs and problems you may have previously faced in the game.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed the error of not being able to choose a new skill when you MAXed most of the other skills.
[*] Ice grenade now works correctly.
[*] Ice saws now works correctly.
[*] Ice emitter now works correctly.
[*] The third location «Ruins» now unlocks correctly.
[*] Corrected errors in descriptions.
[*] Fixed bugs in sound effect.
[*] Fixed instant death by meteorites.
[/list]
 
[b]Gameplay improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Saws are now larger and much more convenient to use.  
[*] Improved controls for the gamepad.
[/list]
Full list of changes [b][url=https://discord.gg/VR4aTg6nNT]here[/url][/b]. Join the [b][url=https://discord.gg/TRHvhDpgGR]discussion[/url][/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/922fbbe0bbf01fc2cac3a3fb34861c7ade4a07ff.jpg[/img]

In case you missed our new cool trailer, [b][url=https://youtu.be/m8xQS2oK8Cc]watch it now[/url][/b] and share what you think about it in the comments on YouTube!

We've also opened up applications for streamers and content creators to apply for keys on Keymailer! If you want to show our game to your subscribers be sure to leave a request: https://www.keymailer.co/g/games/166227

Have a good one and we'll be back soon with fresh news! While you're reading these, we're already preparing a next patch with new cool stuff for the game =)

[b]Cheers,
Sobaka Studio & ESDigital Games[/b]

notes.title: AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Roguelite fast-paced auto-shooter REMEDIUM: Sentinels is now available in Early Access![/b][/h3]

The game is set in the same world as [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659090/REMEDIUM/]REMEDIUM[/url][/b] game. It has been more than a hundred years since the Grey Plague has won turning most humans into vicious mutant freaks, and only a handful of cities still stand amidst the death and chaos that consumed the land.

Now you can take control of a Sentinel created by alchemists with only one goal - defend the cities against the endless hordes of mutants until your reactor dies. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244480/REMEDIUM_Sentinels/

Combine items and alchemical elements to acquire more and more weapons and create unique builds. 

[h3]Easy to play, hard to master![/h3]

[previewyoutube=m8xQS2oK8Cc;full][/previewyoutube]

Since this is an early access release, you can share your ideas how to improve the game on our official [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/nJkZ4rkn5Q]Discord server[/url][/b]. We are always happy to answer any questions and help you if necessary! 

- Sobaka Studio
